Beginner.learningGoal: Raise and catch errors with error and pcall.
gotchas: error with a string adds position info unless level 0 is passed
pcall returns false plus the error value, which may be a table
Errors in the protected function do not propagate
goodSolutionShows: error with tables for structured errors
Returning nil plus message for expected failures
shapeHints: validating a config value and raising
a parse function returning nil, err

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use xpcall with handlers, error levels and error objects.
gotchas: xpcall handler runs before the stack unwinds and in 5.1 does not accept extra arguments
shapeHints: a validation function blaming the caller
a retry helper with an injected attempt count

Advanced.learningGoal: Design resilient APIs: assert idioms, error propagation across coroutines and cleanup guarantees.
gotchas: assert returns all its arguments when true and its message may be non-string
Errors across coroutine boundaries need explicit propagation
Cleanup must run on error as well
goodSolutionShows: Clear distinction of expected failures vs bugs
shapeHints: a with_resource helper that always releases
an isolated plugin hook runner continuing after failures and collecting errors
a command dispatcher that reports errors without crashing
